audit.whatIsWrong: The entire matchup refers to Zaahen's abilities as 'Ultimate'. Not one ability is named anywhere in either layer, and none of the four interactions that actually decide the lane are stated.
audit.why: Four things matter and none reached the page. (1) Aureate Rush (E) is a dash whose damage scales on percent health — Dr. Mundo's whole build is max health, so Heartsteel and Warmog's make it hit harder, and armour does not scale against it. (2) The Darkin Glaive (Q) is an auto-attack reset that heals him, on 10/9/8/7/6, and the RECAST makes the following attack knock you up — so the tell is a wind-up, and the knock-up is a second cast, not the first. (3) His W stabs at 850 range and PULLS you toward him — that is the engage, and it means spacing at cleaver range is not safe. (4) His passive lets him REVIVE at full Determination: a kill in this lane is not necessarily banked.
